title: Towards Batch-to-Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Continuous Control
abstract: arXiv:2603.08588v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art deep reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable performance in continuous control tasks, yet their computational complexity is often incompatible with the constraints of resource-limited hardware, due to their reliance on replay buffers, batch updates, and target networks. The emerging paradigm of streaming deep RL addresses this limitation through purely online updates, achieving strong empirical performance on standard benchmarks. In this work, we propose two novel streaming deep RL algorithms, Streaming Soft Actor-Critic (S2AC) and Streaming Deterministic Actor-Critic (SDAC), explicitly designed to be compatible with state-of-the-art batch RL methods, making them particularly suitable for on-device finetuning applications such as Sim2Real transfer. translated_title: 面向连续控制的从批处理到流式深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 最先进的深度强化学习方法在连续控制任务中取得了卓越的性能，但由于依赖经验回放缓冲区、批量更新和目标网络，其计算复杂度往往与资源受限硬件的约束不相容。新兴的流式深度强化学习范式通过纯在线更新解决了这一局限，并在标准基准上取得了强劲的实证表现。在本工作中，我们提出了两种新颖的流式深度强化学习算法——流式软行动者-评论家算法（S2AC）和流式确定性行动者-评论家算法（SDAC），它们被明确设计为与最先进的批量强化学习方法兼容，因此特别适合设备端微调应用，例如Sim2Real（仿真到现实）迁移。这两种算法在标准基准上均取得了与最先进流式基线相当的性能，而无需繁琐的逐环境调参……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出两种与最先进批量强化学习方法兼容的新型流式深度强化学习算法S2AC和SDAC，使其适用于设备端微调等资源受限场景，并在标准基准上达到与最先进流式基线相当的性能。
